title: Bradley Wiggins Says No One Else Will Win the Tour de France Until Tadej Pogačar Retires
content:
'Tadej all the way': Wiggins says the 2027 Tour de France route won’t stop Pogačar. The 2012 winner explains why he sees no one who can beat him for years to come.
